rule_summary: The federal tuition amount is a NON-REFUNDABLE tax credit. It reduces tax payable; it does not by itself generate a cash refund and it is not paid out in cash. In a given year you can only use enough of the credit to bring federal tax payable to zero; the unused portion is carried forward (or, for current-year tuition, may be transferred). A large refund in a low-income/internship year typically comes from tax WITHHELD at source exceeding the tax actually payable — not from the size of the carryforward. Québec has its own parallel tuition mechanism on the provincial return.
uncertainty_notes: Credit rates and transfer limits are year-specific — verify against the current-year return.
Refundable vs non-refundable is the key distinction users conflate.
